start: Settings, Health apps: 'Sleep and workouts' off; a sleep app writes to Health Connect

steps.action: Switch 'Sleep and workouts' on and allow Sleep in Health Connect
user_sees: "On. After a lighter workout, MettleUp checks last night's sleep. Your sleep stays on this phone and is never sent anywhere."
must_not: Sleep read before the switch is on

steps.action: After a 5-hour night, finish a workout lighter than the last one
user_sees: Under the finish card: 'You slept … last night. A weaker day after short sleep is normal. Aim for 7 hours or more tonight.'
must_not: A sleep line after a heavier workout
A sleep line in an easy week

start: Sleep and workouts On, slept well or no sleep data

user_sees: One protein tip instead, at most once in its spacing
must_not: A number about what the member ate
A tip and a sleep line together

start: Sleep and workouts switch refused or off

user_sees: 'Health Connect isn't letting MettleUp read your sleep yet. Tap "Open Health Connect" below and turn on "Sleep".'
must_not: A sleep line from made-up data

steps.action: Switch off, finish a lighter workout after a short night
must_not: Sleep read while the switch is off

steps.action: Finish another lighter workout the same day
must_not: The same tip twice in a row

start: Sleep and workouts On, member linked to a gym

steps.action: Sleep is read for the finish line
user_sees: Sleep used only for that line on this phone
must_not: Sleep sent to the gym, a trainer, MettleUp's server or any AI
